verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents Talent Matching, part of Real Talent™, which analyzes and filters applications into tiers based on risk and relevance. It also documents Voice AI for top-of-funnel structured screening interviews. The matching feature is described on a dedicated bias-audit-statement page, which points to vendor documentation of a safeguard, but the evidence shows no details of the audit, human-review controls, or other safeguards on automated decisions. missing for 10: details of the bias audit methodology and results, documented human-in-the-loop or override safeguards, a deeper explanation of how matching scores are derived, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: Talent Matching is a core component of Real Talent™, a new Greenhouse feature set designed to help customers tackle overwhelming candidate pipelines by analyzing and filtering applications into tiers based on risk and relevance.
Voice AI is a two-way, voice-based AI interviewing platform that recruiters can use at the top of the funnel, replacing the resume lottery with a structured voice interview.
